Knowledge-corpus manifest and ingestion orchestration (spec 009.2)

Source: R/knowledge-corpus.R
knowledge-corpus.Rd

Public API around the RAG knowledge-corpus manifest (`inst/extdata/knowledge_corpus_v1.csv`, spec 009.1) and the manifest-to-database ingestion pipeline. This promotes the logic that used to live only in `data-raw/build_knowledge_corpus.R` into exported, testable functions, so that a `nemetonshiny` administration tab can edit the manifest and import the corpus **without re-implementing any business logic** (CLAUDE.md rules 1-3).

The packaged CSV is the versioned **seed**; an editable **project copy** is resolved by [knowledge_manifest_path()] (`writable = TRUE`) and seeded from the package on first use (spec 009.2 D1).

Developed by Pascal Obstétar.
